Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.render

Interface SyntaxHighlighter

All Known Implementing Classes:
JavaHighlighter
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface SyntaxHighlighter
Language strategy returning source-preserving token spans.

Strategies return ordered source-preserving token spans. CodeBlockObject controls line layout, selections and timing independently of language syntax rules.
